title: Aromatic Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: Grilled skewers of marinated chicken, inspired by the flavors of Brazil, with an aromatic twist.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine soy sauce, honey, greek yogurt, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until the chicken is well coated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Sprinkle the skewers with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
